propositions: The test monkeypatch stub observed_upsert() accepts only (self, criterion_id, met, evidence, *, source='tool') but the real CriterionBank.upsert() signature gained keyword-only parameters evidence_sufficient and seeded, causing TypeError when production code passes those kwargs through the monkeypatch.

Production code legitimately passes evidence_sufficient=False (in record_insufficient via bounded-fallback path), evidence_sufficient from finalizer, and seeded=True from cache seed, but the narrow test stub rejects them.

The anthropic/openai test arms gathered sufficient evidence and never triggered the bounded-fallback path, so they never called upsert with evidence_sufficient, masking the signature drift; the bedrock arm's timing hit the insufficiency path and surfaced the TypeError.

The fix threads all kwargs through the test stub via **kwargs (extracting to shared helper make_observed_upsert) so evidence_sufficient, seeded, and future upsert kwargs flow unchanged to the real upsert, preserving signal and eliminating the TypeError.
